assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and dizziness, raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia.
The patient has a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks.
The patient is experiencing ongoing giddiness.
A cardiac event monitor (CPT 93271) is medically necessary to correlate symptoms with potential arrhythmic events.
The service is supported by the documented clinical indications on the record.
The appeal addresses denial code CO-22.
